newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse seeks more Lisnave detail.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse seeks more Lisnave detail.

text.p: The Lisbon bourse is seeking more details from ship repairer Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais de Lisboa about its planned restructuring and capital cut before re-admitting its shares to trade, a senior official said.

The bourse suspended trade in Lisnave on Wednesday after receiving a statement in which the company announced the capital cut. It said the move would be put to shareholders at an assembly but gave no date for the meeting.

"The Lisbon bourse believes that investors are not in possession of all the relative facts about the restructuring...and asked for additional clarification," bourse director Luis Rodrigues told Reuters.
"Until the additional clarification is available, the suspension will not be lifted," he said.
